title: Change Record
description: A declared change record referenced by a commit's Change-Record trailer. Author-declared values (intent, declaredRisk, obligation flags) are POINTERS that later beads reconcile against observed evidence; they may only INCREASE required work and MUST NOT reduce any control. A low declaredRisk never lowers an obligation.

id.description: Stable record identity; the record file MUST be changes/<id>.yaml.

intent.description: Closed set of change intents. bugfix additionally obliges a Regression-For trailer.

declaredRisk.description: Closed set of author-declared risk tiers. Advisory pointer only; never reduces a control.

documentation.description: Author declares documentation is in scope for this change (P0.2 reconciles).

changelog.description: Author declares a changelog entry is in scope (P0.2 reconciles).

regression.description: Author declares a regression test is in scope (P0.2 reconciles).

integration.description: Author declares integration coverage is in scope (P0.2 reconciles).

migration.description: Author declares a migration is in scope (P0.2 reconciles).
